svg.title: How remote workers run jobs
svg.desc: 1, Mint a pass: You create an expiring credential for one worker. Its secret is shown to you once and never stored. 2, Lease one job: The worker proves who it is and borrows one approved job. Revoked or expired passes are refused. 3, Run it, locked: It runs the job in the same kind of sandbox the daemon would use, then hands back the raw output. 4, Check and sign: Only the daemon holds the signing key. It checks the output, signs it, and records it. A bad worker can at worst return a wrong answer for its one job; it can never forge a success.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Workers borrow the work. Only the daemon can sign the results.
